name: Giuseppe Gangi
scope: Dedicated Giuseppe audit using his preserved dossier, actual shared-engine fights and this agent's own native T3 tab. Only this report and tests/character-audits/giuseppe.test.ts were written in the repository. No runtime edits, commits or child agents.
sourceRevisionNote: Shared implementation files are untracked in this workspace; the hashes below identify the audited implementation more precisely than the base Git revision.

identityAndPortrayal.preservedDossier: Venezuelan software engineer, data researcher and creator of Macedonia del Norte. Identity and biography are preserved dossier evidence, not newly researched claims.
identityAndPortrayal.referenceViewed: The local studio portrait shows short dark side-parted hair, thick black rounded glasses, a broad oval face and a plain plum sweater. The inspected sprites retain those cues with fictional arcade trousers, shoes and combat poses.
identityAndPortrayal.audio: Dossier specifies generic effort/pain reactions without words and no real-person voice. This audit did not listen to audio or modify audio assets.

movementAndStance.walk: From x540, 24 right inputs reach641.8574192480195; the next24 left inputs reach548.5423043700457. Facing follows movement and both player indices reproduce these positions.
movementAndStance.jump: First jump reaches y454.6 after10 calls. Second jump is accepted; third is rejected. After100 further calls the fighter is grounded at y554 with jumps0 and two stocks on both sides.
movementAndStance.sprites: Production drawSprite rendered all eight actual combat poses in both facings: neutral/presentation0, guard1, running2/3, tucked jump4, open-palm light5, high kick6, recoil7. All inspected heads, hands and shoes were complete; no clipped or borrowed limb, displaced baseline or reversed combat facing was observed.

special.name: Ráfaga de datos
special.distinctBehavior: Three independently spawned data packets travel along the same oscillating path, increasing horizontal speed to the fixed cap. Giuseppe remains stationary during the special.
special.timingConvention: All emission and impact ticks are relative to the completed510-tick intro. Simulation ticks exclude hitstop calls; jump-dodge scheduling below uses zero-based stepMatch call indices.
special.scenario: Poliedro, Giuseppe at x180 and Javier at x460 for P1; mirrored P2 has Giuseppe x900 and Javier x620. Both fighters start grounded with HP100 and energy100. Increment Giuseppe special once at the first playing call.
special.emissions: Both sides spawn at active ticks16,25,34. Surviving first samples already have age1 and velocity +/-4.24; damage6.72 is7*0.96.
special.idle: All three packets land exactly once, at active ticks42,62,82. Each deals6.9216 HP after Javier armor1.03; target finishes79.2352 HP and attacker hits3. Projectiles are gone by180 calls, with no additional impacts.
special.frontGuard: Holding grounded block toward the incoming packets records three block effects, preserves target HP100 and gives the attacker zero hits. Target energy after180 calls is52.12 including held-guard drain. Both sides behave identically.
special.rearGuard: Holding block plus movement away faces the wrong direction. All three packets land at active ticks49,69,89, target finishes79.2352 HP, attacker hits3 and no block effect occurs, on both sides.
special.capAndExpiry: With Giuseppe at x70/P1 or x1010/P2, the rival at the opposite floor edge and initial invincibility200, every observed packet matches abs(vx)=min(11,4+0.24*age), life=85-age, and y=originY+sin(age*2*pi/26)*14. Speed first caps at age30; every packet visits both sides of originY. Last surviving age is84; the three packets disappear at active ticks100,109,118, exactly85 ages after spawning, without hits or boundary removal.
special.jumpDodge: At gap280, Javier jumps on zero-based playing call20 and double-jumps on call40 while Giuseppe fires once. Both sides finish140 calls at HP100, two stocks, attacker hits0 and no remaining packets. A timed double jump therefore avoids the complete burst.
special.energyGate: Energy24 rejects activation on both sides. Energy25 accepts and ends the activation call at0.035 from passive regeneration. Energy100 is75 immediately after activation, before hit rewards.

attacksAndCombos.light: At gap80 both sides connect once for6.9216 HP with outward knockback. Facing guard prevents HP loss. No additional hit occurs after40 more calls.
attacksAndCombos.heavy: At gap80 both sides connect once for12.8544 HP with outward knockback. Facing guard prevents HP loss. No additional hit occurs after40 more calls.
attacksAndCombos.baseCombo: Ping certero, light then heavy, connects both strikes with real approach inputs on both sides. Target finishes77.134 HP after66 active ticks; heavy bonus3.
attacksAndCombos.advancedCombo: Código limpio, light/light/heavy at one win, connects all three strikes with approach inputs on both sides. Target finishes66.0924 HP after112 active ticks; heavy bonus7.
attacksAndCombos.winGate: Separate gap140 input-history probes use two light whiffs then a heavy. At zero wins the name remains Ping certero and bonus3; at one win it becomes Código limpio and bonus7. Whiff-based recognition is existing input-chain design. Fully connected checks are recorded separately.
attacksAndCombos.super: Compilación final requires three wins and75 energy. At gap200, startup9, both sides hit once for40.0464 HP: (28*0.96+12)*1.03. Target finishes59.9536 HP. Zero or two wins reject; three wins with74 energy reject. This definitive uses the shared close-range super rather than a fourth projectile.

cpuFight.method: Complete the intro, idle180 playing calls to exercise CPU offense, then control Giuseppe with real approach, guard, jump, light/heavy/special/super inputs. Run two complete bouts and compare the full final state and recorded move sets.
cpuFight.limit: This exercised deterministic fight demonstrates completion and replay, not balance quality. Dedicated attack tests separately verify the light hit that does not land in this CPU bout.

introAndSelection.name: Presentación de su idea
introAndSelection.controlledChecks: Imported production loadSprite/drawSprite/drawPresentation and renderMatch into this agent's own native tab. Inspected all eight combat frames in both directions; intro and selection at progress0/.32/.65/1 in both directions; production split-screen cinematics with Giuseppe P1 at tick60 and P2 at tick240.
introAndSelection.actualLobby: Used normal lobby search and character buttons to select Giuseppe for P1 and then CPU. Actual Portrait datasets showed respective facing1 and-1, selection progress0 on new selection, then progress1/frame1 at completion. The already completed P1 stayed at progress1 when CPU changed.
introAndSelection.observedMotion: Giuseppe lowers his ready hands, turns/nods his head and displays a translucent mint data card by his forward hand, then returns to guard. The sampled endpoints use combat frame1 and remove the card. Both cinematics retain the face, glasses and hands within their intended upper-body framing and face the rival.
introAndSelection.oneShot: selectionProgress clamps to1 at2800ms and5600ms; entranceProgress reaches1 after168 actor ticks and stays1. Pose and gesture endpoints are ready/rest. Portrait's animation loop stops after progress1. Intro action-gate tests prevent attacks or movement until the shared510-tick timeline ends, then face the rival on either side.
introAndSelection.limitations: Representative static samples, actual selection endpoint datasets and production cinematic snapshots were inspected. Every interpolation frame and audio playback were not reviewed. Native preview was available throughout; no alternate browser or server was started. Own tab was closed after review.

recommendation: Retain Giuseppe's current behavior and presentation. No reproducible Giuseppe-specific defect from this focused audit warrants a runtime or art change.
